highlights: Vicki’s Favorite Ride holds the highest score and the biggest blowout from the same game, winning 210.54 to 76.76 over The Driving Crooners in week 3 of 2023.
Woodys Wams won two games by 0.04 points in 2025, against Diesel in week 3 and The Mayeflower in week 9.
Edik Lester Bomb Squad 💣 had the easiest schedule on record in 2021. In weeks 16 and 17, its opponents ran for −1 yards and then scored zero points.
Diesel set two all-time records in one game, week 2 of 2026 against Tuten and Fannin it 💨: 175.92 offensive points and 578 receiving yards.
Sayer- LA SB owns two marks from 2021: 5,978 receiving yards for the season and 496 rushing yards in a single week.
It’s Alllllen The Hips hit a record 6 field goals against The Mayeflower in week 15 of 2025, and two of its 2025 opponents got zero kicking points.
